title: Man shot, killed by Toronto police officer
article: A 32-year-old man is dead after being shot by a Toronto police officer during an attempted drug arrest.
Toronto police say at 10:30 p.m. Thursday, drug squad officers attempted to arrest two men at a gas station in the city's east end.
During the course of the arrest, said a police release Friday, a police officer discharged his firearm.
A man pronounced dead at the scene has been identified as Courtney Peters, the Special Investigations Unit said in a release.
A second man was taken into custody.
Witnesses said plainclothes drug officers on foot and in vehicles surrounded a vehicle at the gas station.
The driver apparently tried to ram a police cruiser and an officer got out and several shots were fired, according to the report.
The SIU is called in when a serious injury or death occurs during police operations.
